_how: Intro plan. source/audio/audio_offset/sfx come from stems.py. start/end = source seconds of the dialogue (end runs ~0.5 s past the last word: that pause is the silence before the drop). subs = [start, end, text] in source seconds, wording from official subtitles, one caption per speaker turn (intro.py fails the build otherwise). crop_bottom = share of the frame with burned-in subtitles to cut away. edit = the rendered edit to join.
name: example
subs: Take the amplified and the reversal,
then smash together those two different expressions
of infinity to create and push out imaginary mass.
